title: How Element Fleet Management uses fleet card data to cut client costs
summary: Discover how Element Fleet Management leverages WEX fleet cards to enhance efficiency and reduce costs for their global client base.
body_markdown:
### Share


A fleet card program gives fleet management companies the data they need to help clients control costs. In October 2026, the **[Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/ppi/home.htm)** reported a 6.3% year-over-year increase in the Producer Price Index, which measures the change in prices that manufacturers pay to their suppliers. High supplier costs impact the bottom line for many businesses. A viable solution for businesses to address these impacts is to identify untapped operational efficiencies and ways to keep costs down during difficult economic times. This article shows how Element Fleet Management uses a fleet card program to streamline operations and reduce client costs.


## **Element Fleet Management: a global fleet manager built on client relationships**


[Element Fleet Management](https://www.elementfleet.com/) is the largest publicly traded, pure-play automotive fleet manager in the world, providing a full range of fleet services and solutions to a growing base of loyal, world-class clients – corporations, governments, and not-for-profits – across North America, Australia, and New Zealand. By getting to know their clients and how they operate in the field, Element provides tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of their clients through strategic services, daily operational support, and, as Element’s Client Relationship Manager Melissa Bandel describes it, “Solving for when things go bump in the night.”


## **How Element builds a client-centric culture**


Bandel emphasizes the culture at Element and how a shared sense of purpose around client service gives their work meaning. “I love the people here at Element,” she said. “We have people that are really invested in the success of our customers and our business together, and we’re all aligned in creating that client experience that creates a loyal client base.”


## Element Fleet Management case study: better data and streamlined operations


Learn how Element delivers best-in-class service for their global fleet clients through better access to data, streamlined processes, and operational efficiencies.


[Learn more](https://www.wexinc.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1574207602_Element-Fleet-Management_Case_Study.pdf)


## **How fuel card data improves fleet efficiency and growth**


Element’s partnership with WEX, a leading fleet card provider, contributes to Element’s delivery of best-in-class service to their global fleet clients. With the ever-increasing demand for data-driven insights and recommendations, WEX’s partnership has become essential for Element’s operations. As Steve Jastrow, Element’s Vice President of Strategic Advisory and Client Analytics explains it, “Some of the bigger market forces that we’ve seen of late are just the demand for data. Clients want data-driven analysis and data-driven recommendations, and the contribution from WEX is vast. The data is a big piece, and we use that to help understand total cost of ownership (TCO) for the client.”


## What is Level III data? A fundamental tool for fleet managers


Level III data is line-item purchase detail, including product type, fuel grade, cost per gallon, and sales tax, captured at every fleet card transaction. Download the Level III data white paper.


[Learn more](https://www.wexinc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/WEXMF_All-Retail-Partners_1090950-Level-III-data-fleet-managers-fundamental.pdf)


High-quality data from a fleet card provider like WEX helps companies like Element manage and tailor operations more effectively. Level III data capture helps with Driver ID and odometer entry required for each purchase. Fleets that use the WEX card receive detailed information like product type and description, fuel grade, cost per gallon, sales tax, and more.


“The Level III reporting that we get from WEX helps us understand, where do those fuel dollars go? And then just the constant fraud monitoring that WEX does on behalf of our clients is really critical as well,” shares Jastrow.


Darin Ficenec, Vice President of Strategic Alliances at Element, explains how the company uses the data WEX provides to best serve their clients. “Our relationship with WEX goes back to 1991. Over that time, we’ve had to continue to evolve our products and services and our relationship with WEX has continued to evolve… it’s a key part of our products that we bring to market and how we serve our clients.”


## **How a fuel card provider partnership improves your bottom line**


The partnership between Element and WEX is successful due to their shared goal of improving fleet industry tools and practices. “One of the things that I value with our clients is when they treat me like a partner. And the best relationships that we have with our clients are the relationships where it’s more of a partnership. And that’s what we have with WEX is a true partnership and that’s witnessed by the 30-plus-year relationship that we have,” says Jastrow.
